Title: Azure Monitor: New capabilities for diagnostic settings

Body.Content:
Today we are introducing two new capabilities in Azure Monitor for routing your Azure resource diagnostic logs and metrics to storage accounts, Event Hubs namespaces, or Log Analytics workspaces. You can now create multiple resource diagnostic settings per resource (in public preview), and you can route your metrics and logs to a destination in a different subscription.

See the full blog post for information on how to get started with these new capabilities.
